ideas.name: Post-OPEX S&P Reversal
ideas.claim: When VIX expiration follows options expiration, an S&P rally into options expiration is followed by a selloff two thirds of the time, according to the podcast.
ideas.quote: If the s and p is rallying two thirds of the time, it sells off after opex, right?

rules.timeframe: After options expiration; exact duration not stated
rules.filters: VIX expiration follows options expiration; S&P is rallying into options expiration

ideas.claimed_result: The S&P sells off after options expiration in two thirds of the described cases.
